traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +6, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. _Failure:_ 18 (4d8) Cold damage. _Success:_ Half damage. ## Worg
